title: Vegetarian Takikomi Gohan
description: A flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring rice, vegetables, and a hint of soy sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Indulgent Japanese Mushroom and cook until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add the Jeweled Gohan, Takikomi, and Green onions. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Stir in the Soy sauce and Lemon juice. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
